-Elements (12/15): Most major UI components are present, including the candlestick chart, buy/sell buttons, watchlist categories, DXY quote panel, performance cards, seasonal chart, and TradingView branding. Some icons, controls, and sidebar details are simplified or missing.
-Content and Text (30/40): Key labels and values such as “U.S. Dollar Index,” “DXY,” “97.846,” watchlist symbols, performance figures, and bottom navigation labels are largely accurate. The major issue is the chart content: the generated candlestick pattern and price movement differ substantially from the reference, including the timeline trend and plotted values.
-Style (13/15): Typography, colors, borders, green/red market indicators, light grid, and overall TradingView visual language are very similar. Minor differences appear in icon styling, font sizing, line weights, and panel shading.
-Overall (14/20): The page is a strong structural and visual recreation of the reference TradingView interface, but the central chart—the dominant visual element—does not match the reference’s data or shape closely enough, reducing the overall similarity.
